# SuspiciousLoop

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `SuspiciousLoopInspection`

Two loop mistakes: a `for` condition section with several comma-separated
expressions (only the last one decides whether the loop continues), and loop
variables that silently overwrite a parameter of the enclosing function or the
variable of an outer loop.

## Example

```php{2,5,6,12,17,19}
<?php
for ($n = 0; $n < 5, $n != 3; $n++) {}

function scan(array $rows, $pos) {
    foreach ($rows as $rows) {}
    for ($pos = 1; $pos < 3; $pos++) {}
    foreach ($rows as $r) {}
}

class Grid {
    public function walk($cell) {
        foreach ([1, 2] as $cell) {}
    }
}

foreach ($matrix as $row => $cols) {
    for ($row = 0, $k = 1; $row < 2; $row++) {}
    while ($cols) {
        foreach ($cols as $cols) {}
    }
    array_map(function () {
        foreach ([] as $row) {}
    }, []);
    foreach ($cols as $c) {}
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Only the last expression of the &#39;for&#39; condition is evaluated as the condition; combine them with &amp;&amp; or ||.</li>
<li>line 5: Loop variable &#39;$rows&#39; overwrites a function parameter.</li>
<li>line 6: Loop variable &#39;$pos&#39; overwrites a function parameter.</li>
<li>line 12: Loop variable &#39;$cell&#39; overwrites a method parameter.</li>
<li>line 17: Loop variable &#39;$row&#39; overwrites a variable of an outer loop.</li>
<li>line 19: Loop variable &#39;$cols&#39; overwrites a variable of an outer loop.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VERIFY_VARIABLES_OVERRIDE` | bool | `true` | Enables the parameter and outer-loop clash checks (D2–D4). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SuspiciousLoop": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "VERIFY_VARIABLES_OVERRIDE": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SuspiciousLoop

/**
 * @noinspection SuspiciousLoopInspection
 */
```
